125635.overview:
Astro Bomber (アストロボンバー, Asutorobonbā) is a vertically scrolling shooter where players pilot a spacecraft and drop bombs on enemy bases while dodging incoming fire. Timing and precision are key, as players must eliminate targets from above before they are overwhelmed. With simple controls and arcade-style action, Astro Bomber delivers a compact but challenging shooting experience on the go.

The game is very similar to the Konami arcade classic, Scramble.
